not_recorded.why: This run predates the record envelope. Neither the arguments it was given nor the moment it was taken is held anywhere in what it wrote, so neither can be recovered without inventing it. Everything here that is not null was recovered from the record and the directory it sits in. The date below is the day the record first entered the repository, which bounds the measurement from above and is not when it was taken.

note: Every question here is a single-byte read. An address that answers one is there; an address that answers nothing may still be reached by a block read that starts earlier, which this unit is known to do. So a region reported as ending where the map says is bounded by what a single-byte read reaches.

positive_control.why: An address known to answer, asked between regions. A unit that stops talking answers nothing to every question after that, which is exactly what a region ending where the map says looks like. Without this, a run that lost the unit early reports a whole map of regions confirmed.
